name: Fly.io Sprites
description: Run each Orca workspace in its own Sprite, a persistent Linux VM from Fly.io. Adds Sprites under Run on > Per-Workspace Environment.

settings.title: Sprites organization
settings.description: Organization to create Sprites in. Empty: the sprite CLI’s default organization.

settings.title: Sprite name prefix
settings.description: Start of every Sprite name the plugin creates.

settings.title: Orca version on the Sprite
settings.description: Empty: the version of your Orca app.

settings.title: Per-workspace browser
settings.description: Install Orca’s whole desktop app on the Sprite, which the browser needs. Creates take about a minute longer.

settings.title: Keep the Sprite awake while an agent works
settings.description: Off: the Sprite sleeps once no client is connected, which stops a working agent.
